title: Require Service Router Authorship
forbids: operation authorship outside module router leaves; a module router index importing anything except direct local operation leaves; a router leaf cycling through its own index; a leaf whose sole runtime export is not the lower-camel operation or deliberate native group mapped from its kebab-case filename and authored from the matching direct or nested module operation through effect or handler; any extra runtime leaf export; or procedure handlers inside root and module-index composition files
why: Separating procedure authorship from static module composition keeps behavior module-local while the root composition rule retains sole aggregate router implementation authority.
remediate: Author exactly one runtime export in modules/<module>/router/<operation-or-group>.ts. Map its kebab-case filename to a lower-camel operation or deliberate native group and author it through the matching direct or nested module operation with effect(...) or handler(...). Keep deliberate grouped files rooted at the matching module group. Keep helpers private, keep leaves independent of their own index, and use module router/index.ts only to import direct local operation leaves and compose their plain tree. Leave complete import reachability to Knip and complete public operation coverage to generated client and API behavior proof. Keep root router.ts as the aggregate implementation boundary.
message: Service router leaves must author one filename-mapped operation or deliberate native group.
